body_markdown:
Most enrichment tools will fill in a company’s industry and headcount. The harder question is whether your CRM gets updated when that company starts hiring engineers, raises a round, or adopts a competitor’s tool, since those are the signals that tell you to reach out now and not wait until next quarter. This guide covers the B2B data enrichment APIs worth considering for CRM automation in 2026, including what each one actually delivers beyond the basics.


**TLDR:**


- A B2B data enrichment API auto-updates CRM records on a schedule, replacing manual research entirely.
- Look for buying signals like hiring activity, funding events, and technology adoption, beyond basic firmographics.
- Check that your provider supports all four delivery methods: API, flat files, webhooks, and MCP.
- Clearbit is now HubSpot-only; teams on any other CRM need a provider that is not tied to one ecosystem.
- PredictLeads is the only provider in this comparison confirmed across every delivery method and both GDPR/CCPA and SOC 2 Type II certifications.


## What Is a B2B Data Enrichment API?


A B2B data enrichment API is a programmatic interface that takes an input, usually a company domain or an email, and returns structured attributes: company size, industry, location, technologies in use, hiring activity, funding history, and more. Your CRM sends the request, the API sends back fields, and those fields populate or update the record automatically. No one has to open a browser and go looking for it.


That last part separates enrichment APIs from manual research. A rep who wants to know if a prospect just raised a funding round or started hiring engineers has to check LinkedIn, check the company website, check a news search, and hope the timing lines up. An enrichment API does that work as a background call, triggered the moment a lead enters the CRM or on a recurring schedule for existing records.


CRM automation depends on this kind of connection because CRMs are static by default. A contact record created six months ago reflects whatever was true six months ago. Company size changes, people change roles, vendors get replaced, and none of that gets logged unless someone updates the record by hand, which rarely happens at scale. An enrichment API keeps the record current by pulling fresh attributes on a schedule or in response to a trigger. For a closer look at how[B2B data enrichment and CRM signals](https://predictleads.com/blog/b2b-data-enrichment-company-signals-crm/) , see the dedicated breakdown.


The practical payoff is fewer stale fields and less wasted rep time. Instead of a sales team manually checking whether a target account still uses a competitor’s tool or has posted new job openings, the CRM pulls that context automatically and routes it into scoring, segmentation, or[outreach workflows timed to sales trigger events](https://predictleads.com/blog/sales-trigger-events-outbound-timing/) . That is the mechanism behind most CRM enrichment work today: not a one-time import, but a live connection that keeps firmographic and[technographic data](https://predictleads.com/blog/technographic-data-2/) attached to a company record as that company changes.


## How We Ranked These B2B Data Enrichment APIs


Each provider was scored across five dimensions that matter for CRM automation: signal depth beyond basic firmographics (hiring intent, funding events, technology adoption, and categorized news), delivery flexibility (whether the provider supports all four methods: API, flat files, webhooks, and MCP), self-serve accessibility (free trials, transparent pricing, no forced annual contracts), CRM compatibility (native integrations with tools like Clay, Make, and n8n, not limited to a single platform), and compliance posture (GDPR, CCPA, and SOC 2 Type II certification). Providers that only offer static firmographic fill scored lower because CRM automation depends on fresh, trigger-based signals, not one-time imports. Ecosystem lock-in, such as a provider that works exclusively inside one CRM, was treated as a meaningful limitation and not a minor caveat. Coverage claims were assessed against publicly documented dataset scales and delivery methods, not marketing copy alone.

## Clearbit


Since December 2023, Clearbit has been absorbed into HubSpot’s ecosystem as[Breeze Intelligence](https://syncgtm.com/blog/clearbit-review) . If you do not use HubSpot, Clearbit is[no longer an option](https://syncgtm.com/blog/clearbit-review) . That single fact shapes how this tool fits into a CRM enrichment strategy: it is not a general-purpose API anymore, it is a feature of one CRM.


### What They Offer


- Real-time company and contact enrichment that appends 100+ B2B attributes from 250 or more data sources
- Reverse IP Reveal to identify anonymous website visitors at the company level
- Adaptive form shortening and autofill that hides fields Clearbit can enrich while revealing only the ones it cannot
- A HubSpot-native Breeze Intelligence experience that combines enrichment, buyer intent signals, and insights directly inside HubSpot CRM


**Good for** : HubSpot-native GTM teams that need automated firmographic enrichment and visitor identification inside a single CRM environment.


**Limitation** : The biggest downsides of Clearbit in 2026 are the[HubSpot lock-in that eliminates CRM flexibility](https://syncgtm.com/blog/clearbit-review) , credit-based pricing that makes costs unpredictable, and no buying signal capabilities. Clearbit does not track job changes, funding rounds, technology adoptions, or other real-time buying signals, which matters if your CRM automation depends on timing outreach to a trigger event – see how[hiring and tech B2B sales signals](https://predictleads.com/blog/how-hiring-tech-insights-help-close-more-b2b-deals/) drive closes instead of filling in firmographic fields.


**Bottom line** : Clearbit works well for teams already committed to HubSpot who need firmographic enrichment baked into their CRM. Teams on Salesforce, Pipedrive, or any other CRM need a B2B data provider that is not tied to a single ecosystem, and one that layers in hiring,[funding round data](https://predictleads.com/blog/find-companies-by-funding-round/) , and technology signals beyond static company attributes alone.


## Coresignal


Coresignal is a B2B data provider built around professional network and company data sourced primarily from public web crawls, with an emphasis on bulk delivery for data engineering teams. Its dataset covers employee records, job postings, company profiles, and technographic signals, and it positions itself as a raw data infrastructure layer, not a workflow tool. Delivery is through bulk files and API access, and the feature comparison table above notes n8n as its only confirmed native CRM integration.


### What They Offer


- A company dataset with firmographic attributes including headcount, industry, location, and employee counts sourced from public professional network crawls.
- A job postings dataset covering active and historical listings that can be used as hiring intent signals for lead scoring and account prioritization.
- Bulk dataset delivery via flat files for teams ingesting large record volumes into a data warehouse like Snowflake or BigQuery.
- An n8n integration for teams building low-code automation workflows on top of the raw data.


**Good for** : Data engineering teams that need large-scale bulk exports of firmographic and job posting data and can build their own enrichment pipeline and CRM sync layer on top.


**Limitation** : Coresignal’s delivery model puts the integration work on your team. Webhook delivery, MCP support, and native CRM integrations beyond n8n are not confirmed in public materials, which means every workflow that needs push notifications or real-time lookups requires custom infrastructure. Compliance posture, including GDPR, CCPA, and SOC 2 Type II status, is also not specified in public documentation, which matters if your CRM automation operates under data privacy requirements.


**Bottom line** : Coresignal fits teams with dedicated data engineering resources who need bulk professional network and job posting data and are comfortable building the CRM sync, webhook triggers, and compliance review themselves. Teams that need buying signals delivered directly into a CRM without a custom integration layer will find PredictLeads covers the same job posting signals alongside News Events, Technology Detections, and Financing Events, all through a confirmed set of delivery methods including API, flat files, webhooks, and MCP.


## People Data Labs


People Data Labs (PDL) is a B2B data infrastructure provider focused primarily on people-level enrichment: contact attributes, professional history, education, and social profiles for over 1.5 billion person records. It also covers company-level firmographics, including industry, headcount, and location, across roughly 100 million company profiles. PDL is API-first and positions itself as a raw data layer for developers building enrichment pipelines, scoring models, and HR-tech products, not a workflow tool with native CRM integrations. Delivery is through REST API access, with a free tier offering 100 monthly enrichment lookups to get started without a contract.


### What They Offer


- A person enrichment API covering professional history, education, social profiles, email, and phone, with over one billion person records drawn from public and licensed sources.
- A company enrichment API providing firmographic attributes including industry, headcount, location, and revenue range across approximately 100 million company profiles.
- A free starting tier with 100 monthly enrichment lookups and self-serve API access, which lowers the evaluation barrier for smaller teams and developers.
- Dataset licensing for teams that need bulk delivery of person or company records into a data warehouse or enrichment pipeline.


**Good for** : Development teams and data engineers that need high-scale people-level enrichment, such as contact attribute fill, professional history, and email coverage, and want a self-serve API with a free entry point.


**Limitation** : People Data Labs is built around contact and firmographic fill, not buying signals. It does not provide structured hiring intent data, technology adoption signals, funding event tracking, or categorized news events, which means your CRM automation cannot use it to time outreach to a trigger. Webhook delivery, MCP support, and native integrations with tools like Clay, Make, or n8n are not confirmed in public materials, so every workflow that needs push notifications or real-time lookups requires your team to build the sync layer.


**Bottom line** : Choose People Data Labs when your primary need is contact-level enrichment at scale with a free starting tier. For CRM automation that depends on company-level buying signals, including hiring activity, technology adoption, funding events, and categorized news, PredictLeads covers those signals through a confirmed set of delivery methods including API, flat files, webhooks, and MCP, which removes the custom integration work PDL leaves to you.


## MixRank


MixRank is a B2B technographic data provider focused on mobile app intelligence and web technology detection. Its core offering is built around identifying which SDKs, advertising networks, and analytics tools mobile apps use, alongside traditional web script and tag detection across company domains. The dataset positions MixRank as a specialist play for teams whose targeting logic depends heavily on technology stack, particularly mobile technology, and not a general-purpose enrichment or buying signal layer. Access requires an annual contract with a reported minimum of $1,000 per month, and no self-serve trial or free tier is publicly available, which means you need direct sales engagement before you can test data quality against your own account list.


### What They Offer


- Mobile SDK and app intelligence covering which advertising networks, analytics platforms, and SDKs are detected inside iOS and Android applications.
- Web technographic data identifying script tags and technologies on company domains, including competitive technology detections for displacement plays.
- A company and contact database covering firmographic attributes for companies with a known app or web technology footprint.


**Good for** : GTM teams in mobile advertising, ad tech, or martech whose ICP is defined by specific mobile SDK or app technology usage and who need a dataset specialist in that signal type.


**Limitation** : MixRank requires an annual contract and a minimum spend of $1,000 per month, with no self-serve access or free trial to test coverage before committing. Webhook delivery, flat-file exports, MCP support, and native integrations with tools like Clay, Make, or n8n are not confirmed in public materials, which puts the integration work on your team. The dataset does not cover hiring intent, funding events, or categorized news events, so CRM automation that depends on trigger-based outreach timing has no signal layer to draw from.


**Bottom line** : MixRank fits teams with a specific mobile SDK targeting requirement and a dedicated data engineering function to build the CRM sync around it. For teams that need technographics alongside hiring, funding, and news signals through a confirmed delivery stack including API, flat files, webhooks, and MCP, PredictLeads covers all of those signals with source-level evidence on every Technology Detection and a self-serve entry point that does not require an annual contract.


## Crustdata


Crustdata is a YC-backed B2B data infrastructure provider built for real-time company and people data, with 250 or more company data points and 90 or more people data points spanning over one billion people and 70 million companies. It positions itself as event-driven and API-first, with a freshness story built around live crawls instead of batch refreshes.


### What They Offer


- Live web crawls that fetch data at request time, with the Watcher API offering 11 or more distinct webhook types that push real-time alerts for headcount growth,[job openings data and hiring signals](https://predictleads.com/blog/job-openings-data-api-hiring-signals-products-crms/) , funding events, and personnel changes directly into AI agent pipelines.
- Company records covering firmographics, funding activity, hiring trends, web traffic, reviews, technologies, and headcount changes.
- A People Search and Enrichment API with 60 or more filters and 90 or more live data points per person.
- An MCP server for AI agent integration.


**Good for** : AI agent builders and data engineering teams that need event-driven, real-time company signals and can handle building their own CRM sync and workflow layer on top.


**Limitation** : Crustdata is API-first and developer-focused, with no native CRM sync and no outreach capabilities built in. It does not provide an opinionated waterfall for verified mobile phone or email coverage, so you still have to design your own coverage strategy and combine it with other providers to reach high match rates at scale.


Crustdata’s real-time signal delivery works well for AI-native workflows built from scratch. PredictLeads gives you a broader company intelligence dataset for the same kind of automation: source-transparent technology detections, 279.7M+ job openings since 2018, categorized news events across 37 categories, and native webhook delivery: the same signals used when[finding fast-growing private companies](https://predictleads.com/blog/how-investors-find-fast-growing-private-companies/) before funding rounds.

## Frequently Asked Questions


### Frequently Asked Questions


**What is a B2B data enrichment API and how does it work with a CRM?**


A B2B data enrichment API is a programmatic connection that appends structured company data, such as firmographics, technologies, and hiring activity, to a record in your CRM. You send a domain or email, the API returns fields, and your CRM updates automatically, usually through a native integration or a middleware tool like Clay, Make, or n8n.


**What signals should a B2B data enrichment API provide beyond basic firmographics?**


Look for hiring intent, technology adoption, funding events, and categorized news events, since these tell you when a company is changing and not merely what it looks like today. Firmographic fields like industry and headcount matter for segmentation, but a company posting new engineering roles or adopting a competitor’s tool gives you a reason to reach out now instead of later.


**How is a B2B data enrichment API different from a contact database?**


A contact database gives you a static list of names, titles, and emails collected at some point in the past. A B2B data enrichment API updates records on a schedule or in response to triggers, so the data attached to a company stays current as headcount, technology, and funding status change.


**What delivery methods should I look for in a B2B data provider?**


Look for[API access, flat files, webhooks, and MCP](https://predictleads.com/blog/company-data-api-flat-files-webhooks-mcp/) for real-time lookups, warehouse ingestion, push notifications on new signals, and AI agent workflows respectively. A provider that only offers one of these forces you to build extra infrastructure around the gaps, so coverage across all four methods is worth checking before you commit.

### Is PredictLeads better than Crustdata for AI agent workflows that need real-time company signals?


Both support MCP and webhook delivery, but PredictLeads adds 279.7 million+ historical job openings since 2018, categorized News Events across 37 categories, and source-level evidence on every Technology Detection, giving AI agents richer context per company record. Choose PredictLeads when your CRM automation depends on company-level buying signals, including hiring intent, funding events, technology adoption, and partnership moves, and not static contact fields.


### What delivery methods should I confirm before committing to a B2B data enrichment API?


Confirm that the provider supports API access for real-time lookups, flat files for warehouse ingestion into Snowflake or BigQuery, webhooks for push notifications on new signals, and MCP for AI agent workflows. Most providers in this list confirm only one or two of these methods, which forces your team to build infrastructure around the gaps.
